items.informal_name: Coefficients of Polynomial Remainder in Submodule Product After Monic Division
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S)
  (Mp : Submodule R S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ Mp) →
    1 ∈ Mp →
      ∀ (Mq : Submodule R S), (∀ (i : ℕ), q.coeff i ∈ Mq) → 1 ∈ Mq → ∀ (i : ℕ), (p %ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp
items.informal_description: For polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ over a semiring $ S $, if all coefficients of $ p $ lie in a submodule $ M_p $ containing 1 and all coefficients of $ q $ lie in a submodule $ M_q $ containing 1, then the coefficients of the remainder $ p \bmod q $ (when $ q $ is monic) are contained in the product $ M_q^{\deg(p)} \cdot M_p $.

items.informal_name: Coefficients of Division by Monic Polynomial Lie in Generated Submodule Product
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S)
  (hq : q.Monic) (i : ℕ),
  (p.divModByMonicAux hq).1.coeff i ∈
      (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range q.coeff)) ^ p.natDegree * (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range p.coeff)) ∧
    (p.divModByMonicAux hq).2.coeff i ∈
      (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range q.coeff)) ^ p.natDegree * (1 ⊔ Submodule.span R (Set.range p.coeff))
items.informal_description: For any polynomials $p$ and $q$ with $q$ monic, and for each index $i$, the coefficients of the quotient and remainder obtained from dividing $p$ by $q$ belong to the product of the submodule generated by the coefficients of $q$ raised to the degree of $p$ and the submodule generated by the coefficients of $p$.

items.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedDivisionRing K] → Polynomial K → NNReal
items.informal_description: The Cauchy bound of a polynomial $ p $ over a normed division ring $ K $ is defined as $ 1 + \frac{\sup_{0 \leq i < \deg p} \|\text{coeff}_i(p)\|}{\|\text{leadingCoeff}(p)\|} $, where $ \sup $ denotes the supremum of the absolute values of the coefficients excluding the leading term, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the norm on $ K $. This provides an upper bound on the absolute values of the roots of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Remainder Reconstruction via Monomial Sum for Monic Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {n : ℕ}, q.degree ≤ ↑n → ∑ i, (Polynomial.monomial ↑i) ((p %ₘ q).coeff ↑i) = p %ₘ q
items.informal_description: Given a monic polynomial $ q $ and a natural number $ n $ such that $ \deg(q) \leq n $, the sum of monomials $ X^i \cdot (p \mod q)_i $ for $ i < n $ reconstructs the remainder $ p \mod q $, where $ (p \mod q)_i $ denotes the coefficient of degree $ i $ in the remainder polynomial.

items.informal_name: Remainder of polynomial division by a monic polynomial
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
items.informal_description: Given polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ over a semiring $ R $, the function returns the remainder of dividing $ p $ by $ q $ if $ q $ is monic (i.e., its leading coefficient is 1). If $ q $ is not monic, it returns $ p $ itself. The computation relies on classical logic to decide whether $ q $ is monic.

items.informal_name: Natural Degree of Remainder in Monic Polynomial Division is Bounded by Divisor's Degree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) {g : Polynomial R}, g.Monic → (p %ₘ g).natDegree ≤ g.natDegree
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ and a monic polynomial $ g $, the natural degree of the remainder $ p \mod g $ satisfies $ \deg(p \mod g) \leq \deg(g) $, where $ \deg $ denotes the natural degree (the usual degree if non-zero, and 0 otherwise).

items.informal_name: Coefficient Bound for Monic Polynomials with Bounded Roots
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)
items.informal_description: Let $ p $ be a monic polynomial over a field $ F $, and let $ f : F \to K $ be a ring homomorphism to a normed field $ K $. If the polynomial $ p $ splits over $ K $ and all roots $ z $ of $ f(p) $ satisfy $ \|z\| \leq B $, then for every $ i \in \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ f(p) $ satisfies $ \|\text{coeff}_{f(p)}(i)\| \leq B^{\deg(p) - i} \cdot \binom{\deg(p)}{i} $, where $ \deg(p) $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient Membership in Submodule Product for Polynomial Division
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] (p q : Polynomial S)
  (Mp : Submodule R S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ Mp) →
    1 ∈ Mp →
      ∀ (Mq : Submodule R S), (∀ (i : ℕ), q.coeff i ∈ Mq) → 1 ∈ Mq → ∀ (i : ℕ), (p /ₘ q).coeff i ∈ Mq ^ p.natDegree * Mp
items.informal_description: For polynomials $p, q$ over a semiring $S$ with coefficients in submodules $M_p, M_q$ of $S$ over $R$, if $1 \in M_p \cap M_q$ and all coefficients of $p$ (resp. $q$) lie in $M_p$ (resp. $M_q$), then the coefficient of degree $i$ in the monic division quotient $p/ₘ q$ belongs to $M_q^{\deg(p)} \cdot M_p$.
